claims.claim: The authors describe a post hoc planning-cost correction that fits a single constrained dynamics matrix while leaving the encoder, predictor, rollout, and planner untouched.
claims.evidence_quote: The correction is post hoc: the encoder, the predictor, the rollout, and the planner are all left untouched, and only a single constrained matrix, $A$, is fit.

claims.claim: The authors restrict the planning cost to latent directions that the state dynamics carry forward with the least uncertainty.
claims.evidence_quote: We then restrict the $\ell_2$ cost to the $k$-dimensional subspace the state dynamics carry forward with the least uncertainty.

claims.claim: Across six environments, the authors report large gains on TwoRoom and PointMaze, with success-rate improvements over the plain latent-distance cost of up to $+54.7$ points under a harder planning setting.
claims.evidence_quote: We evaluate across six environments and show large gains on the 2D navigation tasks, TwoRoom and PointMaze, raising success rate over the plain $\ell_2$ cost by up to $+54.7$ points under a harder planning setting.

claims.claim: The authors describe independently finding walking and flight contraction metrics offline and unifying them online through an energy-based CLF QP.
claims.evidence_quote: We search for separate domain-specific contraction metrics for walking and flight independently offline and unify them using an online energy-based Control Lyapunov Function Quadratic Program (CLF QP).

claims.claim: The authors report optimal cross-domain control allocation in simulations.
claims.evidence_quote: This enables optimal, cross-domain control allocation, which we show using simulations.

claims.claim: The authors report hardware experiments validating mechanical viability and thruster-assisted trotting; experimental stability motivates deployment of the multimodal control framework.
claims.evidence_quote: We also show experimental results that validate the mechanical viability of our hardware and the paradigm of thruster-assisted trotting. The stability of said experiments motivates the deployment of the control framework for multimodal operations.
